name: 鸿蒙刃寅
body: silken sacred ivory-white and pale platinum gold fur, NOT yellow fur
secondary: dark gold and cool silvery gunmetal armour, pale gold engraved scar-like stripes
light: warm white-gold eyes, pale gold claw tips, restrained gold forehead seal and a faint tail-tip trace
avoid: no ochre/orange tiger, no all-gold body, no huge glow

name: 太初罡猊
body: deep sacred antique gold and luminous bronze-gold, clearly brighter and richer than dirty dark brown
secondary: warm platinum trim, dark bronze and black gold recessed armour, dense luxurious mane
light: restrained golden mane edges, warm white-gold forehead seal and chest carving, pale platinum fangs
avoid: no ordinary yellow lion, no muddy brown or turquoise patina

name: 太易苍虬
body: ancient rich cyan-jade and deep emerald-celadon scales with translucent nephrite material, luminous but not neon
secondary: forest teal, jade green and near-black green scale shadows, antler-like ancient spirit-wood horns, cyan-white whiskers
light: delicate jade-cyan horn light, scale rim light and flowing wood-spirit veins, pale green breath charge
avoid: no dirty grey-green, no plastic green or fluorescent lime

name: 青冥九尾
body: cyan-jade-white, moon celadon white and soft pale emerald fur with clearly defined elegant strands
secondary: spirit emerald and blue-green-grey shadows, nine tails with jade-green rather than navy-blue tips, tiny pale gold ancient markings
light: cyan-white small tail-tip spirit flames, cold jade eyes and soft ear rims; subtle, no broad aura
avoid: no navy/royal-blue tails, no pink, no cartoon or washed-out featureless white

name: 混沌玄鼋
body: deep ocean blue and abyssal blue-black ancient tortoise shell, rich cold sapphire substance with readable sculpted details
secondary: glacial blue, dark marine teal and stone-blue shell plates, subtle silver-blue engraved lines and faint violet frost accents
light: cold ice-white blue eyes, fine glacial blue fissures along shell rims and glyphs, restrained frost at joints and mouth
avoid: no light blue baby turtle, no featureless pure black, no bright cyan neon wash

name: 归墟溟鹏
body: abyssal indigo-blue and deep ocean blue-teal, grand layered feathers retaining each feather's detailed ridges
secondary: moon-white blue, muted silver-blue edge feathers, deep sea grey-blue shadows and tiny sparse silver specks
light: subtle glacial blue wing edges and tidal feather veins, mysterious deep blue eyes and a trace of dark violet in tail
avoid: no ordinary blue bird, no grey dull plumage, no neon electric blue

name: 劫烬朱凰
body: sacred vermilion and red-gold phoenix plumage with warm orange-red divine flame feathers, luxurious sculpted feather layers clearly visible
secondary: deep crimson shadows, fire-feather gold and sunset orange, tiny violet along selected flame edges
light: small warm-white flame core at breast mark, gold feather-tip highlights, red-gold crown and flowing wing/tail rims
avoid: no monotonous dark-red bird, no solid glowing orange blob or overexposed feathers

name: 烛幽赤螭
body: molten crimson, dark gold-red and volcanic red-black dragon scales, rugged lava-shell material distinct from elegant phoenix feathers
secondary: red copper, magma orange and deep ember crimson, local violet-black flame edges
light: white-hot small mouth core, narrow magma fissures between scales, dark gold-red horn highlights and pulsing back ridges
avoid: no pure black dragon, no chaotic giant flames covering anatomy, no phoenix-like decorative gold plumage

name: 玄黄岳麟
body: sacred warm earth-gold, jade ochre gold and ancient mountain brown-gold, dignified luminous stone and jade scale material
secondary: warm sandstone, jade-rock ivory, antique bronze gold, tiny cyan-jade engravings and gold-brown natural striations
light: gentle ivory-jade horn highlights, warm earth-gold guardian chest seal, restrained scale etchings and subtle hoof glow
avoid: no dirty yellow or grey mud, no ordinary yellow deer, no garish gold

name: 太荒镇獬
body: obsidian rock-black gold and deep mountain brown-black with readable grey-gold rock armour planes, austere divine judge
secondary: antique bronze, stone-grey and dark jade-yellow armour seams, sparse red-copper law inscriptions and pale stone edge highlights
light: one restrained gold-lit judgment horn, warm amber forehead seal and thin law glyphs along shoulder/back armour
avoid: no generic grey rock monster, no pure black silhouette, no colorful or flamboyant decoration

name: 混沌祖兽
body: primordial grey-gold, deep charcoal, muted dark violet and abyssal blue-black, mysterious regal ancient source material with readable sculptural details
secondary: subtle aged metallic grey-gold ridges and dark teal-black recesses; reserve five elemental colors for very sparse thin veins
light: small chaos-white eyes and chest core, tiny gold/celadon/blue/vermilion/ochre hairline veins, extremely restrained ancestral energy
avoid: no rainbow patchwork, no evenly spread five colors, no featureless black, no huge glowing halo
